verdict.rationale: Shopify exposes each merchant's catalog to agents through the per-shop Storefront Catalog UCP endpoint and aggregates listings into the Global Catalog. Runtime probes confirm both endpoints are live and that live catalog search works, and marketing says merchants get discovered across AI channels without lifting a finger. However, publication is an automatic platform exposure, not a documented merchant-facing feed or import API, and every doc in the pack describes the agent/consumer side. missing for 10: a documented merchant-side feed/import or publishing API, documented merchant opt-in or channel controls for which surfaces receive the catalog, and a path for non-Shopify catalogs.
